entry.title: The Lie I Was Told About Discipline
entry.summary: Discipline is not about wanting to. Discipline is about doing it anyway when the return is not visible yet.

entry.title: On Love That Does Not Perform
entry.summary: I keep writing about love because I keep trying to understand it as practice, not performance.

entry.title: Ten Books Before Twenty: Why I Could Not Stop
entry.summary: I reached ten published books before twenty. The real answer is that I could not stop.

entry.title: What I Mean When I Write About Faith
entry.summary: Faith in my work is not decoration. It is the wound I keep returning to because it has not resolved.

entry.title: The Court and the Page Are the Same Discipline
entry.summary: People ask how I balance basketball and writing. I do not. They have never been separate.

entry.title: What Black Boys Are Not Allowed to Feel
entry.summary: There is a performance tax placed on Black boys before they ever learn to speak. This is me refusing to keep paying it.
